derivation: The checkpoint is D2-115's resulting state: the same inner fan-out holds two pass-1 rows under two different outer objects, and each outer object's obligation waits on its own child pass. LIFE-019 requires a WAITING obligation to name one existing unique child pass with the exact kind, construct, pass, common outer enclosing prefix and complete obligation inventory, and COMPOSITION states that outer_enclosing distinguishes passes whose numerical pass values restart in different contexts. Fan-out passes are keyed by fan-out identifier, pass and expand occurrence, so admission must select each reference's pass by its outer prefix rather than by construct and pass number alone. Both references resolve, so the checkpoint is admitted, and the available CLOCK sample is retained with an empty reason set and no other change.
